$Comment: The Uncommon Lantern Bomb's blast: every creature within 3.5 blocks of the bomb takes damage, a shove and the game's own burning (Hallows_Eve_Lantern_Burn: Burn carrying the Lantern Bomb tag, so the burn counts as the blast's). Players are never hurt: the one hit rule matches only an entity that is not a player, and with no plain HitEntity a player matches nothing. IgnoreOwner also keeps the thrower out. All damage is the game's own Fire, credited to the thrower, so a creature's fire resistance softens it. The Hit tag marks every hit as a Lantern Bomb's, which a mod that rewards bomb damage can key on. Range is the radius in blocks; BaseDamage and Knockback.Force set how hard it hits.
